policy.name: protocol_derived_fee_activation_consistency
policy.description: After an observed fee-activation update, the declared V3 owner and V2 feeTo must jointly match the proposal's adapter and TokenJar. The property is derived from the protocol fee-switch semantics and is checked at every transaction boundary.
independent_basis: Uniswap V2 protocol-fee specification: a nonzero feeTo enables protocol-fee collection and routes it to feeTo.
Uniswap V3 factory specification: owner is the authorization state for setOwner.
Proposal 94 specifies the adapter and TokenJar destinations for the paired updates.

limitations: The replay population is the three destination domains assigned to Vote 1; Celo is outside this declared subcase.
The independent specifications define each component's fee and authorization semantics, but do not promise atomic cross-domain activation; the replay therefore makes no atomicity claim.
No exploitability or financial-loss claim is made.
